title: Impact of Cancellation of High Speed Rail Project on Development Plans for Jurong Lake District and Related Areas
what_it_is: Impact of Cancellation of High Speed Rail Project on Development Plans for Jurong Lake District and Related Areas

sections.label: Jurong Lake District HSR implications
sections.summary: Malaysia's HSR cancellation does not change Jurong Lake District plans, which predate the HSR and use acquired land for housing, gardens and transport.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam
sentences.text: asked the Minister for National Development with regard to Malaysia's decision to cancel the High Speed Rail (HSR) Project, what are the implications for (i) development plans for sites along the Singapore stretch of the HSR, especially in the Jurong Lake District and (ii) land acquisition for the proposed HSR.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: We started this endeavour to build urban centres outside the downtown area with the building of our first regional centre at Tampines in 1992, and then we started the work to transform Jurong in 2008.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: The plans for Jurong Lake District were developed well before Malaysia proposed the HSR Project.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: It was only in 2015, after further study of the HSR proposal, that we decided to locate the Singapore terminus of the HSR in Jurong.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: (a) The development of a commercial precinct and the injection of up to 20,000 new homes; (b) The upgrading of Jurong Lake Gardens, including the Chinese and Japanese Gardens, with a new Science Centre integrated within the Gardens; and (c) The development of a major transport hub connecting the existing North-South and East-West Mass Rapid Transit (MRT) Lines, as well as the upcoming Jurong Region and Cross Island Lines.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: The land parcels that the Government has acquired are needed to realise these plans.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: The Jurong Country Club site will provide for new mixed-use developments and community facilities.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: The Raffles Country Club (RCC) site is needed for the Cross Island Line's (CRL's) western depot and other transport-related uses.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: Regardless of the outcome of the HSR Project, the overall impetus and vision for Jurong Lake District have not changed.
